intro.heading: The Wedding of
intro.message: By the grace of Allah, we invite you to share in the joy and blessings of our wedding celebration.
intro.verseArabic: وَمِنْ آيَاتِهِ أَنْ خَلَقَ لَكُم مِّنْ أَنفُسِكُمْ أَزْوَاجًا لِّتَسْكُنُوا إِلَيْهَا وَجَعَلَ بَيْنَكُم مَّوَدَّةً وَرَحْمَةً
intro.verseTranslation: And among His signs is that He created for you spouses from among yourselves, so that you may find tranquillity in them, and He placed between you love and mercy.

countdown.heading: Counting the days
countdown.endedMessage: Alhamdulillah. Thank you for celebrating with us.

blessing.heading: A Prayer for the Couple
blessing.arabic: بَارَكَ اللَّهُ لَكَ، وَبَارَكَ عَلَيْكَ، وَجَمَعَ بَيْنَكُمَا فِي خَيْرٍ
blessing.translation: May Allah bless you, shower His blessings upon you, and unite you both in goodness.

wishes.heading: Wishes & Duas
wishes.intro: Leave a dua or a few kind words for the couple.

closing.message: May Allah bless our union with love, mercy, happiness, and endless barakah.
closing.footer: Made with love for our special day.
